item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:45 HKT 08/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A ridge of high pressure will bring generally fine weather to the coast of southeastern China tomorrow. It will be hot with weak winds on the Mid-Autumn Festival and the following couple of days over the coast of Guangdong. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A relatively dry continental airstream will bring fine and very hot weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will move in the general direction of the seas east of Taiwan in the next few days and intensify gradually.
